issue_context.title: Setting Rotation and GlobalPosition for Control causes runaway Position issues.
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.dev4.mono.official [df78c0636]

### System information

Godot v4.3.dev4.mono - Windows 10.0.22621 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5161) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 Threads)

### Issue description

Setting the GlobalPosition of a control while it's Rotation is non-zero can cause runaway issues with the controls position.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/1730988/437decae-d74f-44f8-83b3-3e18d1f12c01



### Steps to reproduce

In the repro, hold down left mouse button to see the issue happening.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ControlPositionRotationBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/14609095/ControlPositionRotationBug.zip)

review_comments: I would have to check in detail, but isn't this missing the handling of [CanvasItem.top_level](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_canvasitem.html#class-canvasitem-property-top-level)? Also haven't checked in detail, but I believe a top level Control would have its `parent_canvas_item` null, so its `position_in_parent` here would be `p_point` (the target global position). So this may be good already?
